Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Route Ludhiana to Kanpur

Dear Vertex Retail Team,

Please be advised that vehicle PB59PM4997 has experienced a breakdown and is being replaced by unit PB47CH2654.
The replacement vehicle has been dispatched from the Ludhiana hub and is currently en route to Kanpur.
We estimate an arrival time of approximately 21.3 hours from the time of dispatch.
We will continue to monitor the shipment closely and provide further updates as necessary.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
